name: gafgyt-349d2476-bench
description: Command timeline for Gafgyt 349d2476 (Snoopy.c build). The wire format was recovered by emulating the sample's own parser (analysis/simparse.py), not by reading disassembly: the bang must be followed by exactly one space, argv is space-separated, and a comma-joined line collapses to a single token that the bot rejects. Offsets are milliseconds from accept(), so every trace runs the same sequence.
